QuestInfo.name: The Gift for the Empress
QuestInfo.0:
The Empress has been a great help thus far.
You want to express your gratitude to Her Highness...
QuestInfo.1:
You can obtain a gem called #rPeridot#k from #bRashes#k, the spirits of the #bMinar Forest#k.

Collect #r5 Peridots#k from #bRashes#k and #bDark Rashes#k by the #bWest Forest of Leafre#k and the #bWestern Border of Leafre#k, and take them to the Empress.
QuestInfo.2: You have delivered the emerald-tinted gem, #rPeridot#k, to the Empress.

1.0: I can feel the power of the sun radiating from those gems! You've done so well!

yes.0: I have blessed you with strength.\r\nThough my magic is still weak, you will have greater reserves of health and magic. Take a look at your Skills and see for yourself.\r\n

0.msg: Bring #r5 Peridots#k obtained from Leafre's #bRashes#k and #bDark Rashes#k.
